claims.statement: Regulation 2023/1542 requires accurate, complete, current battery-passport information linked through a QR code and identifier.
The Commission states that passports become mandatory for specified EV, light-transport, and industrial batteries on 18 February 2027.

contrary_evidence: Enterprise vendors and suppliers may bundle adequate passport tooling.

economics.acquisition_route: Unvalidated hypothesis: testing labs and battery integrators.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Unvalidated hypothesis: 500 models at 18000 PLN recurring annual revenue yield 9 million PLN ARR and founder equity above 5 million PLN in five years.
economics.founder_time: Unvalidated hypothesis: 15 hours weekly with retained counsel.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Unvalidated hypothesis: 70% after review, storage, and support.
economics.payback: Unvalidated hypothesis: onboarding fees cover acquisition before recurring revenue.
economics.pricing: Unvalidated hypothesis: 10000-40000 PLN onboarding plus 500-2500 PLN monthly.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Unvalidated hypothesis: batches, supplier changes, and long availability duties create switching costs.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Reusable supplier evidence lowers onboarding cost and expands exception knowledge
fingerprint.customer: EU battery importers and small assemblers
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Managed evidence ingestion and passport hosting
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The operator pays at model onboarding, issuance, and updates
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A covered battery model must enter the EU market with accurate passport data

founder_fit: Automation and data governance fit a part-time wedge with bought legal expertise.
risks: Incorrect records could block market access.
Delegated acts can force rapid rework.

structure.control_point: A supplier-to-model evidence graph with provenance and exception history
structure.critical_dependency: Accurate evolving rules and upstream supplier cooperation

thesis: A managed passport system turns fragmented supplier attestations into compliant records and a reusable evidence graph for smaller battery importers and assemblers.
title: Battery Passport Foundry
uncertainties: SME counts, integrations, and outsourcing appetite remain unknown.
